intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ (Mockito / StepVerifier where reactive) tests for RecordTelemetryService, asserting only against ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @Service. Constructor(TelemetryLedgerRepository, Clock). Never re-validates or reorders. record: Validated/ValidationFailed event -> if no revision exists append ORIGINAL (revision 1, failed payload retained); if one exists and value or status differs append CORRECTION, otherwise return the latest unchanged (idempotent replay).
